title: 3MF Bio: an open schema for recording biofabrication end to end
description:
An open schema, built on the 3MF package format, for recording biofabrication work end to end in a single file: material identity and synthesis route, cell provenance and authentication, formulation and rheology, print process across twenty modalities, deposition heads and nozzles, calibration events, staged post-print maturation with bioreactor and stimulation regimes, and assays measured over a timecourse.

Its organising constraint is that every numeric parameter must declare where its value came from, enforced by XML Schema, ISO Schematron and a reference validator.

It is not a standard and asserts no acceptance thresholds. It supplies the fields so that laboratories and manufacturers can record against their own criteria. Filling them is not compliance.
notes: Pre-1.0 working draft. Not affiliated with the 3MF Consortium; follows their schema conventions so packages remain readable by ordinary 3MF tools. No real dataset has yet been recorded in this schema - see review/DATASET-SHEET.md.
